_doc: Player character creation rules for TalesForge.CharacterCreation: the stat point buy from rules/core_mechanics.md (75 points, 3-18 per stat), the race stat choices from rules/races.md, the background skill points per class, the derivation inputs for a new player character and the starting kit. Race and class labels come from defaults.json.

races.human: Versatile and resilient; humans adapt quickly, thriving on trial and error. +1 to any two stats.
races.elf: Graceful, long-lived and attuned to nature and magic. +2 DEX, +1 INT or WIS, -1 CON.
races.dwarf: Sturdy craftsfolk who endure harsh conditions. +2 CON, +1 STR, -1 CHA.
races.gnome: Curious tinkerers who treat failures as experiments. +2 INT, +1 DEX, -1 STR.
races.halfling: Cheerful, social and lucky in danger. +2 DEX, +1 CHA, -1 STR.
races.half_elf: Bridging two worlds, with human adaptability and elven grace. +1 DEX, +1 CHA.

classes.none: No trade of arms or magic: your past and your choices speak for you.
classes.warrior: Trained to fight: melee, tactics and a hard stare.
classes.thief: Quiet hands and a quick tongue: stealth, locks and lies.
classes.ranger: At home in the wild: bow, tracks and survival.
classes.cleric: A voice of faith: insight, persuasion and old stories.
classes.wizard: A student of the arcane: arcana, history and insight.
classes.druid: Bound to the land: survival, arcana and tracking.
